definition.proposition: Gated DeltaNet recalls better than plain linear attention / Mamba-2
definition.refutation_criteria: The check is **valid** only if attn ≥ 90% and swa(32) ≤ 30%. If not, it's inconclusive and must be redesigned. / **C16** (vs plain linear attention) is `VERIFIED` if mean gdn accuracy ≥ mean linear-attention accuracy + 10 points over the 2 seeds. Mamba-2 isn't tested, so the best possible status is `PARTIAL`, worded as "vs plain linear attention".
